citations.quote: Most agents try to close by pushing harder. They explain more, they send more options, more payment plans, more follow-ups, and the client still disappears.
This is where neuroemotional persuasion comes in. You learn how to ask better questions.

observation.text: The speaker presents common ineffective sales tactics before introducing an alternative method, neuroemotional persuasion. They first list what most agents do wrong, and then explain the concept's fundamentals.

summary.text: The post lists common objections such as 'I need to think about it,' 'I'm not in a rush,' and 'Now is not the right time.'

citations.quote: This is where neuroemotional persuasion comes in. You learn how to ask better questions. So instead of convincing the client, the client starts convincing himself.

summary.text: Neuroemotional persuasion involves learning to ask better questions so the client convinces themselves rather than being convinced by the agent.
